session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling... tired. Like everything is too much to handle.
I'm sorry to hear that. You're not alone in feeling this way, and it's okay to need help.
Thanks. I just... don't know how to stop feeling like this. It's like I'm stuck in a loop.
It's understandable to feel stuck sometimes. You're doing your best, and that's more than enough.
Yeah, I guess. But I keep thinking about the wedding. I don't want to go, but I don't want to hurt them either.
It's hard to be in that situation. You're trying to be kind, and that's a strength.
I know. But every time I think about it, my head starts to spin. I can't even imagine being around them.
You're not alone in feeling that way. It's okay to feel overwhelmed, and you don't have to face it all at once.
I just... don't know how to make it better. I feel like I'm not even trying anymore.
You're trying, even if it doesn't feel like it. You're allowed to feel stuck, and that doesn't mean you're failing.
I know. But sometimes I feel like I'm just waiting for something to break. Like I'm already broken.
It's okay to feel that way. You're not broken, and you don't have to fix anything right now.
I just wish I could feel like I'm not... stuck. Like I could be free, even for a little while.
You don’t have to be free all the time. Just being here, in this moment, is enough.
Yeah... I guess. It's just hard to believe that. I keep thinking about all the things I can't do.
You don’t have to do anything you’re not ready for. It’s okay to take things one step at a time.
I just... don't know where to start. Everything feels too big.
You don’t have to start with everything. Even small steps can feel like progress.
I guess... I just need to take one step, even if it's tiny.
